krea-2-turbo.title: Krea 2 Turbo, 8-bit, Draw Things cloud compute
krea-2-turbo.notes: Verified 2026-09-26 through Bridge Mode at 1024x704, 1152x768 and 2048x1344: about 90 s per 2K image, 15 to 50 s before the first step. Distilled: keep 8 steps and CFG 1.0; the negative prompt is ignored. Shift 3.16 is Krea's own mu=1.15; the app's preset uses Euler A Trailing with shift 3.0, which is equivalent in practice. default_scale 32 is what unlocks sizes above 1024 px on a side.

ideogram-4.title: Ideogram 4, 8-bit, Draw Things cloud compute
ideogram-4.notes: Prompt is a JSON caption (ideogram-prompt skill); pass the .json file and it is minified before sending. Verified 2026-09-26 through Bridge Mode at 1024x704 and 2048x1344 (about 100 to 150 s at 8 steps). Guidance 7 works for captions up to about 500 Qwen tokens (the renderer counts them); above that the guided branch degrades and past 1000 tokens the image is noise, while the same caption at CFG 1 renders cleanly and at CFG 3 comes out posterized. Ideogram's own presets run 20 steps (default) or 48 (quality); 8 steps look over-baked. The app renders the same long captions cleanly at guidance 7 (Ideogram 4 remote, Expand Prompt to JSON off), so the ceiling belongs to this API path and is not yet explained; it is not a property of the model.
ideogram-4.prompt_max_tokens_note: through the API, guidance 7 breaks down as the caption grows: fine to about 500 Qwen tokens, posterized at 3, garbage above 1000; long captions render well with --cfg 1
